Hi team,

Thanks for the runbook draft. Attached is our updated scope (pentest-scope-v2.pdf) — the key changes from the proposal:

- Exclude third-party SaaS integrations (payments/provider portals) from authenticated testing.
- Include the internal admin console (admin.redwood.ai) and the staging web cluster (staging-1) for authenticated checks.
- Add mobile API endpoints used by the iOS app: /api/v1/auth, /api/v1/payments (rate-limited).

Can you confirm whether the staging environment you requested (staging-1) is reachable via the VPN credentials we shared last week? If not, we can provide a temporary jump host.

Im also attaching the minimal remediation log template (remediation-log-20270316.xlsx) wed like you to use when you capture findings — please include CVSS where applicable and an acknowledgement column for expected fix windows.

Proposed start: Monday 22 Mar, 09:00 PT. If that works, please send over your PO and the final engagement letter so our procurement team can sign off.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sr. Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Thanks Priyom — received and reviewed. A couple of quick clarifications before we lock dates: 

1) SSO: Your note says exclude third-party SaaS integrations but include the admin console. Does the admin console use the same IdP (Okta) as customer portals? If so, well need a scoped test token rather than full Okta admin creds to avoid drifting into customer identity data.

2) Staging access: We tried the VPN creds from last week and the staging-1 subnet is still behind a jump host. Can you provide an SSH jump host and the username we should use? A sample access_instructions.txt is attached — please confirm the exact hostnames and a short-lived service account.

3) Deliverables: We can start 22 Mar but would prefer a 2-week window (22 Mar	2 Apr) to allow for retests. Draft timeline attached (report-timeline-draft.pdf).

On CAIQ/SIG evidence: our standard asks for network diagrams and the SOC 2 scoping statement. Can you drop a redacted network diagram to the Drive link you provided?

Once we have the access matrix and PO well schedule onboarding calls with the test leads.

Best,
R. Singh
Eng Lead, PenTestLab
eng@pentestlab.com
